name: Extra Erratic Mutation
body:
Through wizardry, pluck or talent, you have become able to improve your mutation powers.

Prerequisite(s): Ouphe, Constitution 15, character level 9

Benefit(s): You may choose to enhance an additional mutation per day.

Special: You may take up to four times in total, but each time you do, the Constitution prerequisite to be able to pick it increases by 2.
